scope.quote: The GTE launchpad system includes a reward distribution mechanism where users who hold launched tokens during the bonding phase earn rewards from trading fees. When users buy or sell tokens in the GTE launchpad system, any pending rewards that should go to the user are incorrectly sent to the Launchpad contract instead. This happens because the reward distribution function always sends tokens to the caller (msg.sender), but during token purchases, the caller becomes the Launchpad contract rather than the user. Since the Launchpad contract has no mechanism to recover or redistribute these tokens, user rewards are permanently lost.
The issue is in the `_distributeAssets` function within the Distributor contract, which handles sending rewards to recipients.
